Synopsis:
After killing the final rat during the Ultimatum stage, one of the final rats returns to its humanoid form as Lyrthindor,  the Last Justiciar. He's furious that the player has blown his cover, and quickly turns hostile.

Cluster Contexts:
- SHA_LastJusticiar_JusticiarAppears.json: During the Ultimatum stage the player has just killed the final rat spy; that creature suddenly reverts into its humanoid form as Lyrthindor, the self‑proclaimed Last Dark Justiciar. He is dazed and in pain as he recoils at his restored hands, then immediately accuses the player of prying and blowing his cover—claiming he kept watch over Lady Shar’s temple after the others were killed. This links directly to the Shar‑temple material Shadowheart has been reading, so a nearby companion (especially Shadowheart) may react or have personal stakes in the revelation. Lyrthindor becomes hostile almost instantly, so player lines (questioning, defiant, or apologetic in the samples) will quickly lead to combat or a violent confrontation.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_SpeakWithDead.json: The player turned the Last Justiciar back into a humanoid by killing his rats. The player then proceeded to kill the Last Justiciar and talk to him using Speak With Dead.The Last Justiciar witnessed the Orthon attack and has been using his rat form to hide for years
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsNegotiate.json: The player continues to kill the rats. The rats begin to group up and attempt to bargain with the player. Their memories are starting to converge into a single consciousness of the last dark justiciar. Some players who accepted a quest from the Orthon may realise there is a Dark Justiciar in hiding, amongst these rats. If the player repeatedly talks to the rats at this point without accepting a truce, they'll turn hostile.
- DEN_ShadowDruid_Denouncing.json: You have confronted Kagha about being a Shadow Druid. This has initiated the transformation of the rats into shadow druids before your very eyes. The shadow druids welcome the circle into their fold; you have to fight, or convince Kagha to come around, which will be very hard - and even harder if the kid died before. Olodan the shadow druid is their leader; slobbering and sleazy.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsUltimatum.json: After killing too many rats, the swarm confronts the player in a chamber beneath the Orthon's lair. A fight ensues immediately afterwards.

context: You have just killed the final rat during the Ultimatum stage and the corpse suddenly reverts into a dazed, humanoid form: Lyrthindor, the self‑styled Last Dark Justiciar. He is disoriented and in pain as he looks at his restored hands, then angrily accuses the player of prying and blowing his cover — claiming he kept watch over Lady Shar’s temple after the others were killed. That claim links to the Shar‑temple material a nearby companion (especially Shadowheart) may have been reading, so companions could react with personal stakes. Lyrthindor turns hostile almost immediately, so any player responses (questions, apologies, defiance) will rapidly escalate into combat; earlier events (rats’ memories converging or bargains) explain how his identity was hidden among the swarm.
